question: What universal scope should be encompassed in this meditation at every locus?
premises: The meditation is performed in place after place
The object of meditation is that reality
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality pervading all levels from Śiva to Avīci
plain_english: Having meditated in every place on that which ranges from Śiva down to Avīci,
